// One-hot encoded counter. Translates to a 10-bit binary counter with a
// period of 1000 cycles, equivalent to a periodic signal with the same
// period.
module TopModule(input clk, input reset, output reg [9:0] q);
    reg [2:0] cnt;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            cnt <= 0;
            q <= 10'b0000000001;
        end else begin
            case (cnt)
                0: begin cnt <= 1; q <= 10'b0000000010; end
                1: begin cnt <= 2; q <= 10'b0000000100; end
                2: begin cnt <= 3; q <= 10'b0000001000; end
                3: begin cnt <= 4; q <= 10'b0000010000; end
                4: begin cnt <= 5; q <= 10'b0000100000; end
                5: begin cnt <= 6; q <= 10'b0001000000; end
                6: begin cnt <= 7; q <= 10'b0010000000; end
                7: begin cnt <= 8; q <= 10'b0100000000; end
                8: begin cnt <= 9; q <= 10'b1000000000; end
                9: begin cnt <= 0; q <= 10'b0000000001; end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
